notes.title: Notice on Future Updates to “Boyhood's End”
notes.notes:
Dear Players,
Thank you for playing “Boyhood's End”!

Until now, the game has adopted a manga-style “serialization,” updating roughly every two weeks. Many of you have told us this format is confusing. We have taken this feedback seriously and will change our operation as follows.

Change in serialization format
Updates for all users will now be delivered chapter by chapter.
The small updates we previously released about every two weeks will be pushed to the beta branch. We plan to update it every Friday night (JST).
Your feedback is extremely important, so if you’re willing, please try the beta branch!

How to play the beta branch:
・Open your Steam Library.
・Right-click “Boyhood's End” and select Properties.
・In the window that appears, click the Betas tab on the left.
・From Beta Participation dropdown, choose public-beta. 
・Close the window and the game will update automatically.

We recommend backing up your save data before playing the beta:
Save data is shared between the release version and the beta branch and migrates automatically, so you can continue playing in the beta.
However, if you save in the beta branch and then load that save in the release version, bugs may occur. Please back up your saves before starting the beta.

You can access your save data as follows:
・Open your Steam Library.
・Right-click “Boyhood's End” and choose Manage → Browse local files.
・When the file browser opens, open the www folder.
・The save folder contains your save data.

*The entire folder works as a single save folder. Please copy the whole folder when backing up.

Contact:
Please report bugs, ask questions, or leave feedback via theBugs, Feedback & Impressions form on the Community Hub.

Notes:
(1) Content in the beta is under development and will undergo many changes before the official update.
(2) Unexpected issues may temporarily prevent play. Thank you for your understanding.

That’s all for today’s notice.
We will continue working to improve the game experience and we appreciate your cooperation!

notes.title: 『Boyhood's End』enters Early Access! & plans regarding Chapter 2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!
At last, 「Boyhood’s End」has entered Early Access on September 6th!
The game will be on sale at 10%OFF to celebrate the launch!
Get it now at its cheapest!

[strike]*Note
Regrettably, we have to notify you of the delay of the Digital Artbook and the Digital Soundtrack.
We apologize for the inconvenience.
We will update the store page as soon as the problem is solved.[/strike]

※2024/9/6 13:30(JST)
The Digital Artbook and the Digital Soundtrack of "Boyhood's End" has been released!
We apologize for the delay.

▼Determination Trailer（Episode 1 launch）
[previewyoutube=1v_-yxNTf-U;full][/previewyoutube]
We would like to talk about future updates.

■ Plans for Chapter 2 & Pricing
「Boyhood’s End」is an episodic adventure game.
The story is planned to unfold over 5 chapters through 2025, with the price being adjusted incrementally after each chapter addition.
(If you already purchased the main game, you can play through all 5 chapters without any need for additional purchases)

At the beginning of early access, only Chapter 1 will be available to play, and Chapter 2 is scheduled for release in mid-December 2024.
Details on the specific release dates for each chapter and the price adjustments will be announced periodically on the WSS playground official social media and Steam news page as the development progresses.

■ Regarding the Demo of Boyhood's End
The demo version of the game will be delisted after the release of the Early Access on September 6th.

We would like to thank everyone who played and for all the feedback!
We hope you enjoy the game as well.

■ Regarding content creation of the game
We would like to ask you to place a link to the Steam page of the game when you Stream or upload a video.
If there is no space to place the URL, please give the store page a shoutout!

This will make us very happy!
▼Steam store page URL
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2403290/_/

Another thing that would make us happy would be leaving a review of the game! 
Any opinion helps us!
If you find any bugs or issues, feel free to notify us in the community!

Enjoy the galactic railroad journey that goes off the rails and turns destructive because of 「humans」and 「inhumans」

Hello!

■New Key Visual
We have revealed a new key visual!

The two main characters, "Giovanni," a boy with the lowest "human score" among the entire human race, and "Camperanella," a delinquent boy genius, are depicted.

■Announcement of the price
The title will be completed with 5 chapters, which will be added with major updates.
The price of the base game will be increased in stages as each chapter is added. 

*You will be able to play the whole game without additional payment.

The early access on September 6th will include the first chapter, and the price will be 10.99 USD (tax included).

Details on the specific major update dates and price change schedule for each chapter will be announced as they become available.

Please consider purchasing early for the best price!

notes.title: Notice: Boyhood's End Serialization Start Date Postponed
notes.notes:
Dear all,

In order to improve the quality of the game, we have decided to postpone the serialization of Boyhood's End to Autumn 2023.

In light of this postponement, we've received a message from Tobita from buriki clock, the developer:

--------------------------------
I'm very sorry for the delayed release!
Right now, I'm having the best time of my life as a creator.
This game is full of all kinds of challenges. From the setting, the art, the characters, to the story...
Every day, from morning to night, I put in my whole soul into development.
And now I'm behind schedule! So we have to postpone release.
But it's not something I can help. I must continue working on the game until I'm fully satisfied with it.
The producer is probably crying right now, but I'll just have to make him wait!
So please keep looking forward to the game!
--------------------------------

We'll continue to work hard on the game, so please wait just a little bit longer. We're sorry for the delay!
